281501054.description: This is a polished citrine quartz crystal sphere measuring 3.5 inches in diameter. The sphere features golden-yellow coloring with translucent honey tones, internal fractures, white mineral inclusions, natural banding, and cloudy veil-like patterns typical of genuine quartz. It weighs approximately 1 lb 13.1 oz as measured on a digital scale. The mineral composition was confirmed with a Presidium Gem Tester II, showing readings consistent with quartz/citrine. The sphere is in nice condition with no visible chips or damage to the polished surface. A small clear acrylic display stand is shown for photographic purposes only and is not included with the item.
